item.title: Teach It Lao Without Losing Thai
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. A 27B model that writes good Thai answered Lao requests in Thai, and got the meaning right. What it got wrong was which language it was in. A run that repairs the target language and wrecks the neighbour still wins a target-only leaderboard. 1. What a 5.5 looks like# Together ran a batch of experiments in November 2026 and asked Qwen3.
